summary.zh: 加热并搅拌让硝酸钾全部溶解，再让热饱和溶液缓慢冷却，观察白色晶体重新析出，理解溶解度随温度变化。
summary.en: Heat and stir to dissolve all the potassium nitrate, then let the hot saturated solution cool slowly and watch white crystals grow back — solubility depends on temperature.

model_scope.zh: 用溶解度表按温度插值（教学近似，按 100 g 水折算），溶解与结晶都是有限速率过程；不模拟晶核形成细节。
model_scope.en: A solubility table interpolated over temperature (teaching approximation per 100 g water); dissolving and crystallizing are finite-rate processes; nucleation details are out of scope.

objective.zh: 加热并搅拌，让烧杯底部的硝酸钾固体全部溶解（约需 70 °C）。
objective.en: Heat and stir until all the KNO₃ at the bottom dissolves (around 70 °C).

hint_ladder.zh: 边加热边搅拌，溶解会快很多。
hint_ladder.en: Stirring while heating speeds dissolving a lot.

hint_ladder.zh: 溶解度随温度升高而增大，60 °C 以上进步明显。
hint_ladder.en: Solubility rises with temperature — progress is clear above 60 °C.

hint_ladder.zh: 别把温度推到 95 °C，会触发安全锁定。
hint_ladder.en: Do not push to 95 °C — that triggers the safety lock.

objective.zh: 停止加热，让溶液慢慢冷却，观察白色晶体重新析出。
objective.en: Stop heating and let the solution cool slowly; watch white crystals come back.

hint_ladder.zh: 耐心等待降温——温度越低，能溶解的越少。
hint_ladder.en: Be patient while it cools — the colder, the less can stay dissolved.

hint_ladder.zh: 析出的不是“新物质”，还是原来的硝酸钾。
hint_ladder.en: The crystals are not new stuff — still the same KNO₃.

objective.zh: 读取结晶完成后的最终温度，和溶解时的高温做对比。
objective.en: Read the final temperature after crystallization and compare with the dissolving temperature.

hint_ladder.zh: 用温度计做最后一次测量。
hint_ladder.en: Take one last reading with the thermometer.

title.zh: 完成一次溶解-结晶循环

question.zh: 热的硝酸钾饱和溶液降温后，最可能看到什么？
question.en: Cooling a hot saturated KNO₃ solution will most likely show…

notes.zh: 溶解需要约 70 °C，但 95 °C 会触发安全锁定；建议分段加热并随时测温。
notes.en: Dissolving needs about 70 °C, but 95 °C locks the session; heat in stages and measure often.
